## Conversion Factors

- **1 Btu/lb** = 2326.1 J/kg = 0.55556 kcal/kg
- **1 J/kg** = 0.00043 Btu/lb = 2.39×10⁻⁴ kcal/kg
- **1 kcal/kg** = 1.80 Btu/lb = 4187 J/kg

## Definitions

**Gross (High) Heating Value**: The amount of heat produced by complete combustion of a unit quantity of fuel when all combustion products are cooled to the initial temperature and water vapor is condensed.

**Net (Lower) Heating Value**: Obtained by subtracting the latent heat of vaporization of the water vapor formed during combustion from the gross heating value.
